overview.text: Katrina Manning was elected to the Hawthorne City Council in November 2022 and served as Mayor Pro Tem from April 2024 to April 2025. She is a licensed realtor. Her official biography says she secured a $750,000 grant for a new public restroom at Holly Park and coordinated an exterior remodel of the Holly Park Library. It also states she initiated a book drive for Pasadena schools affected by the 2025 Eaton fires.
